title: Zucchini Cheddar Boats
subtitle: with Warm Freekeh and Currant Salad
description: Sail away for dinner with these tasty cheesy zucchini boats. Simply bake until tender, then serve with a warm wholegrain salad with sweet currants and Middle Eastern spices.

steps.text: Cook freekeh: Preheat the oven to 200C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Put the freekeh in a medium saucepan with 1L (4 cups) water and 1 tsp cumin and coriander spice blend, season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, partially covered, for 15-18 mins until tender. Drain.
Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Finely chop the onion. Trim the zucchini and halve lengthwise, then cut each half in half on an angle. Coarsely grate the cheese.

Bake zucchini: Put the zucchini on the lined tray and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 10-12 mins until almost tender. Top with the cheese and bake for a further 5-8 mins until golden and tender. Meanwhile, put 3 tsp olive oil, 3 tsp red wine vinegar and 1½ tsp honey in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.

Make salad: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, garlic and 1½ tsp cumin and coriander spice blend, stirring, for 3 mins or until softened. Stir in the freekeh and currants and season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat. Add the spinach and half the dressing and stir well to combine.
Serve up: Divide the zucchini boats and freekeh salad among plates. Drizzle with the remaining dressing and enjoy.
Make it yours: Feeling nutty? For extra crunch, scatter over toasted pine nuts, chopped walnuts or flaked almonds.
